'—' : '$' + Number(n).toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})); const v = x => (x === null || x === undefined || x === '' ? '—' : x); return [ `Bill #${v(b.IdBill)}    •    Invoice ${v(b.InvoiceNumber)}    •    Total ${fmtMoney(b.TotalDue)}`, '', `Client:  ${v(b.ClientName)}`, `Vendor:  ${v(b.VendorName)}`, `Utility type:  ${v(m.serviceType)}`, `Account #:  ${v(b.AccountNumber_Raw || b.AccountNumber)}`, `Meter #:  ${v(m.meterNumber || m.normalizedMeterNumber)}`, `Service period:  ${v(appsmith.store.intervalsStartDate)}  →  ${v(appsmith.store.intervalsEndDate)}`, `Invoice date:  ${v(b.InvoiceDate)}`, `Address:  ${v(m.serviceAddress?.fullAddress)}`, '', `Arcadia account id:  ${v(b.ArcadiaAccountId)}`, `Arcadia meter id:  ${v(m.id || appsmith.store.intervalsMeterId)}` ].join('\n'); })() }}
